name: Broad identity-continuity transfer beyond a résumé

attribution.legal_posture: Source-qualified defensive abstraction only. The stated evidence class covers a defensive abstraction; legal identity, nationality, employer compromise, prevalence rate, and adjudicated fact require separate sources.

caveats: Fraudulent employment and fake-interview malware remain separate analytic tracks absent explicit same-case evidence.
The record retains only bounded source context; account names, emails, credentials, and raw selectors stay outside it.
The record excludes people, personas, accounts, companies, victims, images, contact details, payment selectors, credentials, raw network indicators, and leaked material.

Accent, ethnicity, nationality, appearance, location, camera or audio quality, productivity level, consumer email, shipping change, meeting feature, and technical anomaly are contextual signals; fraud or DPRK attribution requires independent evidence.
This was a controlled bait identity rather than an ordinary victim applicant.
Use behavior and continuity signals only in combination with independent verification, consistently applied human review, least privilege, and an appeal or correction path.

statements: The played call requests personal details, language style, portfolio material, and remote computer access. Raney says the operation created LinkedIn, résumé, Indeed, and Gmail artifacts in his name and asked for personal-account access before applying for jobs.
Treat requests to create or transfer control of email, professional-network, job-board, or portfolio accounts as an identity-lending pattern.
Check continuity among account creation dates, recovery channels, historical activity, portfolio provenance, and the person appearing across interviews.
limitations: No account names, emails, credentials, or raw selectors are retained.
This was a controlled bait identity, not an ordinary victim applicant.

statements: Retain the source's observation class and do not generalize a controlled test, speaker claim, vendor sample, or demonstration into measured prevalence.
